title: Network Policy Agent v1.3.5+ assumes the ClusterPolicyEndpoint CRD is installed

detection.reason: the rule asks whether a CRD is ABSENT; the hint names the networking.k8s.aws CRDs that are present

quote: Removing CPE CRD checks as the CRD should be installed by default
remediation: From Network Policy Agent v1.3.5 (bundled with CNI v1.21.2) the agent no longer checks whether the clusterpolicyendpoints.networking.k8s.aws CRD exists before watching it. On EKS the control plane installs it; on a self-managed install apply the CRD from the release before enabling network policy enforcement.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd clusterpolicyendpoints.networking.k8s.aws -o name 2>/dev/null || echo 'MISSING clusterpolicyendpoints.networking.k8s.aws'  # MISSING = install the CRD before running Network Policy Agent v1.3.5+ with enforcement on
